GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2015-05-21T13:29:24Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: vs plugin, 1.5beta regression: can not extend from class in external import
Description: this works in older versions.

when I have the following code in 1.5beta:

```
import refs = require("../refs");
var xlib = refs.xlib;

export class PjscBe extends xlib.ClassBase{}
```

I get the following error:
`265  Cannot find name 'xlib'.`

this issue goes away if I remove the extends.  I can use my external module in other ways just fine:
`var log = new xlib.diagnostics.logging.Logger(__filename);`
